title: Recording: Mary Had A Little Lamb by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio Two, Island Studios, London
Producer: Glyn Johns
Engineers: Phil Ault

Paul McCartney finished recording Wings’ second single, ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’, on 2 April 1972.

The session took place at Island Studios in London. The only remaining overdubs needed were vocals during the chorus, and some Moog synth played by McCartney during the finale.

Joining him in the vocal book was were Linda McCartney and daughters Heather and Mary, who sang on the record.

‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’ was mixed the following day, and released as a standalone single in May 1972.

Page last updated: 20 November 2025
